name: comp-463
title: Pagination Rows Per Page
blurb: Pagination with rows per page selector.
description: Pagination with dropdown to change results per page (items shown per result set).
use_when: Pagination where users can adjust how many items appear per page.
avoid_when: Fixed page size or when users don't need control over results per page.
a11y: Semantic pagination with accessible dropdown for page size selection.
